description: Unit tests for parsing and converting X.509 distinguished names, including handling of various ASN.1 string types, OIDs, and RFC2253 formatting.

classes.name: X509NameAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute of an X.509 name, capable of converting ASN.1 encoded data to string.

methods.name: LoadTestData
methods.description: Loads test data from a PEM file based on specified prefix, value type, and suffix.

methods.name: ParseName
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 DER encoded distinguished name into a sequence of relative distinguished names.

methods.name: SequenceValueFromString
methods.description: Converts a string representation of test data into ASN.1 sequence input for parsing.

methods.name: ConvertToRFC2253
methods.description: Converts parsed distinguished name sequence into RFC2253 string format.
